name: Billing Honesty (nothing sold that cannot be charged)
note: Every mutation here restores a shape the screen actually had once: a purchase button with no store behind it, an entitlement granted by a timer, a price assembled locally.

mutations.name: the no-store provider claims it can take money
mutations.why: isAvailable is what the UI asks before showing a purchase button. If it lies, the app offers a sale it cannot complete and the player's tap goes nowhere.
mutations.expectFailure: must never report that it can take money

mutations.name: the entitlement is granted on success alone, without ownership
mutations.why: This is the exact shape that turned the remove-ads screen into a giveaway announcing itself as a sale. A store can return success for a flow that ended without a purchase.

mutations.name: the banner offers the purchase without asking whether it can be bought
mutations.why: canPurchase is the only thing standing between a build with no billing library and a button that takes the player to a dead screen.

mutations.name: the price is assembled in the app instead of taken from the store
mutations.why: Currency symbol, separator and placement differ by country and the store already knows. Formatting here is how a literal "({price})" once reached the screen. The first attempt at this mutation used product?.priceAmount, which contains product?.price as a substring and so slipped past the first assertion — the runner reported WRONG_REASON rather than crediting the wrong check.
